chapter: Back to Los Angeles and joining Basie
title: Seeing his parents again and the young Charles Thompson and Wild Bill Davis
summary: In Kansas City he saw his mother and father for the first time since leaving and heard the young players Charles Thompson and Wild Bill Davis.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Well now, you'd, I take it you'd come home to see your parents in a way?
Yes. That's where I saw Wild Bill and I had, just as soon as I got to Kansas City, because you see I had seen my mother since I left home after graduating from highschool.
I went to Los Angeles and then went to China and then came back and then came to Kansas City. That's the first time I'd seen her, my
mother and father, so that's where I went down and heard these guys blowing from ... fades out).
It was more, others there, but you wouldn't know them. Nobody knows anything about them.
